sloka: नित्यमुत्साहयुक्ताश्च वाचः श्रुत्वा त्वयेरिताः ।वर्धिष्यते दाशरथेः पौरुषं मदवाप्तये ।। ५.३९.११।।।।
transliteration: nityamutsāhayuktāśca vācaḥ śrutvā tvayeritāḥ ।vardhiṣyate dāśaratheḥ pauruṣaṁ madavāptaye ।। 5.39.11।।।।

translations.english: "On hearing your ever spirited words his manliness to get me back will be charged.
